title: Anyone else wish they had more developer friends? 👋
excerpt: Hey everyone! I've been thinking lately about how cool it would be to know more people who genuinely...
content_html:
Sparks interest in forming a casual dev collective

Hey everyone!

I've been thinking lately about how cool it would be to know more people who genuinely enjoy building things, sharing ideas, and just talking about life.

I'm really into Python, AI, web development, and experimenting with random side projects. But I'm also the kind of person who enjoys a good conversation that has absolutely nothing to do with coding.

I'd love to meet more people here, whether you're an experienced developer, a student, or just someone who gets excited about technology.

No networking pitch, no awkward formal introductions. Just good conversations, exchanging ideas, helping each other out, and hopefully building some real friendships along the way.

A few things I'd love to know:

What are you working on or learning lately?

What's something outside of tech you're really into?

Would you ever be up for building a fun little project with an online friend?

Feel free to drop a comment or send me a DM! I'd genuinely enjoy getting to know people here.

Looking forward to meeting some awesome people! 😊
